visualCharacteristics.purpose: horizontal carousel of fixed-size product photos with (+) hotspot buttons that open product info cards (name, color, View product link) beside the button, kept inside the slide; the first hotspot starts open; prev/next arrows and a progress bar
visualCharacteristics.description: White background. Intro row: H3 left, paragraph + green pill CTA right (two-column intro header). Below: full-bleed Splide carousel of 5 tall product photos with (+) hotspot buttons that open white info popovers; prev/next arrows and green progress bar.

contentPattern.structure: One row per slide. Cell 1: product photo. Cell 2: one group per hotspot, each starting with a heading (H5 product name), followed by an optional position paragraph giving the hotspot centre as x/y percentages of the slide, measured from its top-left (e.g. "40% 60%", "40, 60" or "x: 40, y: 60"), a color paragraph and a "View product" link. Hotspots without a position get default positions. Slides are fixed-size like the source (315x464 mobile, 410x516 desktop), so positions stay on the same spot of the photo
contentPattern.description: Image carousel of 5 product photos; 7 hotspots in total (slides 3 and 4 have 2 each), each popover = product name (h5), color, "View product" link | Image-only slides with (+) hotspot buttons that open product popovers (name, color, View product); 1-2 hotspots per slide

usage: Use for lookbook product imagery where each photo calls out one or more products.
reuseGuidance: For article cards use carousel-article; for video cards use carousel-video.
